parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of candidate numbers. This parameter is optional. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: IsVirtual
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use a virtual number for outbound calls.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description:
The skill group bound to the agent.

To specify multiple values, use SkillGroupId.1, SkillGroupId.2, SkillGroupId.3, and so on.
